row.title: FAILMINE-1: mine, classify, register, escalate and measure every failure
row.body: Failures nobody registered are mined from issues, CI, executor and audit ledgers, classified by root cause, registered as fm-discovered-* with a detector when unregistered and seen 3x, escalated as Q-RECUR-* (2x mutate, 3x incident), measured at /failures. First reading 173 failures, 71% recurrence, 35.5 h median remediation; top classes merge-conflict 54 and stuck PRs 50. fm-tests-red root cause: tests/foundation/test_outreach.py shadowed by scripts/test_outreach.py (renamed, guard test). Seed worker imported ../../../workers/core so a seed checkout failed 28 tests; vendored with identity test, monorepo-only tests listed.
